entities.summary: Dominic Barton, known as Bao Damin in China, is a Canadian business executive, author, and diplomat. He is the current chairman of the private investment firm LeapFrog Investments and was the Chancellor of the University of Waterloo from 2018 to 2024. He served as the Canadian Ambassador to the People's Republic of China from 2019 to 2021. Prior to this, Barton was the Global Managing Director of consulting firm McKinsey & Company, from 2009 to 2018 and has previously served as Chairman of Teck Resources and as Non-Executive Director at the Singtel Group in Singapore and Investor AB in Sweden.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a high-ranking diplomat and business executive, Dominic Barton has played a significant role in shaping Canada's relations with China, particularly during his tenure as Canadian Ambassador from 2019 to 2021. His efforts have had notable regional implications for trade and diplomacy.
